SELECT COUNT(*) AS roster_count,
       COUNT(j.major_id) AS matched_major_count,
       COUNT(j.college) AS matched_college_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN j.college = '' THEN 1 END) AS empty_college_count
FROM main.member AS m
LEFT JOIN main.major AS j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major;

arguments.sql:
WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT j.college, COUNT(*) AS major_count
    FROM main.member AS m
    JOIN main.major AS j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major
    WHERE j.college IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY j.college
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM college_counts
WHERE major_count = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM college_counts)
ORDER BY college
LIMIT -1
